final: WITH g AS (SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorResults WHERE raceId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY raceId), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT g.raceId, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total AS ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN tot WHERE tot.total IS NOT NULL AND tot.total <> 0), avg_r AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM r WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.raceId, r.cnt, r.ratio, r.ratio - avg_r.avg_ratio AS diff FROM r CROSS JOIN avg_r WHERE avg_r.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
